_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja CaptainsCabin/Kajuta Kapitana - biuro (118 terminow, ~25 mikroscen) - gabinet Mortugi z obrazem tajemniczej kobiety (Felicia), mechanika Zelaznego Dzwonu (przygotowanie do opuszczenia go na Kociol w Illusion Theatre), statek w butelce, globus, biblioteczka ze zwojami.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_BG/Secti.en:
It's not his bedroom.
It's more... like his office.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_BG/Secti.pl:
To nie jego sypialnia.
To bardziej... jak jego biuro.

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_FeliciaP.en: ...maybe we should take another look at this.

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_FeliciaP.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Why's it hanging over the desk?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Uh-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: -is that a bell?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: I... think so.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Ah.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: But it's probably easier if we use the handle.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Ale pewnie łatwiej będzie użyć korby.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: So what now? Do we just turn the rope winch ourselves?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Więc co teraz? Po prostu sami obracamy wciągarkę linową?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: ...I guess we [i]could.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

I, uh-
I don't see a handle.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: That's because it's not in this room.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Bo jej nie ma w tym pokoju.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: It's open.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Ale pewnie łatwiej będzie użyć korby.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Looks like it's [i]exactly[/i] the right size for the Bell to go through.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Wygląda na to, że jest [i]dokładnie[/i] odpowiedniego rozmiaru, żeby zmieścił się przez nie Dzwon.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: So, what now? Do we just - turn the rope winch ourselves...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Więc co teraz? Po prostu - sami obracamy wciągarkę linową...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: ...I guess we [i]could.[/i]

I, uh-

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Bo jej nie ma w tym pokoju.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: But-
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: So the Bell's attached to a [i]rope winch...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Więc Dzwon jest przymocowany do [i]wciągarki linowej...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Presumably so it can be lowered onto the cauldron.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Prawdopodobnie po to, żeby można go było opuścić na kocioł.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Yeah, no - we'll need to clear a [i]path[/i] for it first.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: No tak - najpierw będziemy musieli oczyścić dla niego [i]drogę.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Maybe it's time we took another look at this [i]'Iron Bell'.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.pl: Może czas jeszcze raz przyjrzeć się temu [i]'Żelaznemu Dzwonowi'.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.en: Let's discuss it
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_IronBell.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.en: It's just going to hang in the middle of the room?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.pl: Będzie po prostu wisieć na środku pokoju?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.en: You can reach it, can't you?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.en: Then I don't see the problem.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.pl: W takim razie nie widzę problemu.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_Ladder/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.en: It's a ship in a bottle.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.en: Would you not [i]shake[/i] it like that? You're gonna break it.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.pl: Może byś tak nie [i]potrząsał[/i] tym? Zepsujesz to.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.en: I think it already [i]is[/i] broken, listen;
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.en: Something got loose on the inside.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ShipinaB.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_bookshel.en: A lot of these aren't books, they're scrolls...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_bookshel.pl: Dużo z tego to nie książki, tylko zwoje...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_bookshel.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_boxes/Se.en: Why keep them in here, I wonder...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_boxes/Se.pl: Zastanawiam się, czemu trzyma je tutaj...?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_boxes/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_eyes/Sec.en:
What's that saying?
[i]If walls had eyes...?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_eyes/Sec.pl:
Jak to się mówi?
[i]Gdyby ściany miały oczy...?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_eyes/Sec.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_frames/S.en: It's written in a language I don't recognise.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_frames/S.pl: Napisane w języku, którego nie rozpoznaję.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_frames/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ropes/Se.en: They're for hanging the bell from the ceiling.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ropes/Se.pl: Służą do zawieszenia dzwonu u sufitu.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_ropes/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_rug/Sect.en: It's old, but it's not quite as dusty as the rest of the room...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_rug/Sect.pl: Jest stary, ale nie jest aż tak zakurzony jak reszta pokoju...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_rug/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.en: A candle, on a skull, on a book.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.en: So was Mortuga a pirate, or, what?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.pl: Więc Mortuga był piratem czy jak?
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.en: I don't think he actually did any pirating...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.pl: Nie sądzę, żeby faktycznie zajmował się piractwem...
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_skulljun.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_window/S.en: It looks directly out the back of the ship.
Examine/Exam_Area_CaptainsCabin_window/S.speaker: Grimoire
